items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: He was on that one of uh, Gahye. Just on something like Gahye but better looking than Gahye but by that side.

ctx.x: Well I still can't figure out when Celestan fits in. What did he do?

When you played with Celestan I can't figure out how that fits in. Oh I don't, I didn't play with him steady. That's a couple of times he hired me to play second trumpet. I didn't play with Celestan steady. I see. I know what he did. One time I went to Gulfport, Mississippi with him. Played a dance and I went to Bergaloochee one time with him. But not steady playing with him. I had my own band. I see. Who was that guitar man who got poisoned with Jack Kerr? His name was, oh he was a spook. Now what was that guy's…
He might have been sneaking out a lot of back doors too. Oh yeah. And nobody knew about it. So you couldn't figure it out then. Yeah you,
